name: Two Sigma
summary: Two Sigma describes up to three rounds of 60-minute code-pair technical interviews, followed by interviews about your experience and interests. Candidates also report a recruiter screen and a HackerRank online assessment before the technical rounds.

rounds.name: Recruiter screen
rounds.what: Motivation, interest in finance and technology, past projects and other processes.

rounds.name: Online assessment
rounds.what: HackerRank test with LeetCode-style problems; one report also had short multiple-choice questions.

rounds.name: Technical interviews
rounds.what: Code-pair sessions in C, C++, Java or Python on data structures, algorithms, OO design and concurrency, sometimes with a design exercise.

rounds.name: Experience interviews
rounds.what: Discussion of past projects and contributions; you may decline to discuss confidential work.

tips: Analyse the problem before coding and ask for clarification when needed.
Consider memory and performance; Two Sigma notes brute force is not always enough.
Interviewers give hints if you are stuck, so keep talking.
Two Sigma says AI tools are strictly prohibited during interviews.
Prepare to discuss your past projects in depth.
